description: The Statistics Office of the St Helena Government publishes the 2021 Population and Housing Census main report with an Excel file of its 56 reference tables. Housing tables give, for each of the eight districts, households by dwelling type and tenure, rooms, water supply split into treated, untreated and spring or stream, connection to the public sewerage system, rainwater tanks and piped hot water. The energy table counts solar water heaters, electric lighting and primary and secondary cooking fuel (electricity, gas, wood). Other tables cover roofing material and fire protection equipment, telecommunications services, vehicles and boats, empty dwellings and district profiles with area and population density; a companion set compares 2016 and 2021. Coverage is island-wide for St Helena. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF, no registration; the census page also links reports back to 1861. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: counts are small, so some cells are suppressed with a dash; Ascension and Tristan da Cunha are not covered. Simulation uses: sewer connection, rainwater tank and solar water heater shares by district for water and energy planning on an isolated island. Related records: none closer in the catalogue.
